text.tspan: – weight the residual by the code's own anisotropy

g.text: a WEIGHT on the prediction residual
built: w = 1 / sqrt(var(z) + eps) , detached , normalised to mean 1
WHAT IT ACTS ON – the code's variance spectrum, measured
one bar per latent direction, log-spaced, normalised to the largest
top 10 of 384 directions carry 48.5% of the variance
PER SEED – above the line = a win
THE TWO DOSES – against the +0.09 bar
dashed line = what an 8-seed arm needs
the intervention does not move the diagnostics it should
